scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:labs: concurrently -n lab1,lab2,client -c blue,magenta,green "SIMULATION_MODE=replay npm run dev -w server" "PORT=3002 MAP_FILE=lab_2.json DB_FILE=lab_2.sqlite SIMULATION_MODE=live npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
